entries.reason: Tag recall collapses without reasoning: 54.7% mean, 0.2% on meetonmain — the whole-venue vegan rule never fires. Item recall is fine (92.7%) but the dietary tags are the point.
Truncates long menus: submitted 64/180 items on meetonmain (35.6% item recall). Cheapest and fastest level but unusable on multi-page venues.
Tag recall 62.7% mean, 21.5% on meetonmain; item recall 61.7% there. Strictly dominated by xhigh at ~3x the cost.
Worst tag precision of the sweep (93.1% mean, 72.2% on woodenspoon — inferred vegetarian tags) and item recall 85.8%. No axis where it wins.

Worst row of the sweep: lowest item precision (75.6% mean) and lowest tag precision (86.9%). Both headline failures land here — meetonmain tag recall 12.1% (whole-venue vegan rule never fires) and newyorkfries item precision 24.0% (38 invented size variants). The provider default behaves like ~medium; xhigh fixes both. Pass --effort xhigh explicitly.

Dominated by openai/gpt-5.6-luna at every level. Best-vs-best (pro@max vs luna@xhigh): item recall/precision a dead heat (95.8/95.3 vs 95.7/95.2) but tag recall is WORSE (83.3 vs 96.8), 4x slower (461s vs 119s) and ~10x the cost ($0.94 vs $0.098 per 4-task sweep). Reproduces both of luna's signature failures (newyorkfries size-variant hallucination, meetonmain whole-venue vegan miss) and produced the only failed run of 57 (woodenspoon@max, 9m TimeoutError). Per-level billed cost also varied 4-8x per token for unexplained reasons.

entries.reason: Weakest row of the terra sweep: lowest item recall (87.7%) and lowest tag recall (60.7%), with meetonmain tag recall at 0.0% — the whole-venue vegan rule never fires without reasoning. Dominated by low/medium at ~1.2x the cost.

Strictly dominated by low and medium at effectively the same price ($0.164 vs $0.173/$0.171 per 4-task level): lower item recall (90.9 vs 92.3/95.4) and lower tag recall (77.5 vs 86.1/78.7). No axis where it wins.

Most expensive config of any sweep ($0.757 per 4-task level, 19x luna@xhigh; 290s) yet WORST item scores of the terra sweep (87.0/88.4). Effort inverts on newyorkfries: it renames items rather than extracting them verbatim ('Nacho Fries' -> 'Nacho Fries with Queso'), collapsing to 65.4/65.4. TRADEOFF ACCEPTED: this was the only config across all three models pairing 96.5% tag recall with 100% tag precision — pruned on cost/item-accuracy anyway, per user decision 2026-07-31.
